package.name: robot_control_brain
package.description: Online ANN training node for indoor localization on TurtleBot3 Burger. Trains a 15-10-5-2 feedforward network (log-sigmoid hidden, linear output) on 15 features (IMU x6, Odometry x5, KF positions x4) during GPS-available outdoor segments. Publishes learned position estimates on /ann/trajectory for use in the GPS-denied indoor BT branch. Weights are persisted to models/nn_weights.pt across runs.
